title: Europium and ytterbium complexes with o-iminoquinonato ligands: synthesis, structure, and magnetic behavior

synthesis.procedure: Under rigorous exclusion of oxygen and moisture (Schlenk line or argon glovebox), a vinous THF solution of dpp-IQ (379 mg, 1 mmol in 30 mL THF) was added with stirring to an excess of Yb shavings (1.73 g, 10 mmol) activated with iodine (10 mg, 0.04 mmol). The mixture turned deep-green in 1 h and was stirred overnight at ambient temperature to give a red-orange solution. After filtration, THF was evaporated to dryness. Two portions of n-hexane (2 × 10 mL) were condensed onto the henna-red residue and removed in vacuum to give a yellow-orange powder. Orange-brownish crystals of 1 suitable for X-ray diffraction were obtained by slow extraction with 15 mL of n-hexane (412 mg, 70%). An alternative salt-metathesis route used potassium o-amidophenolate (from exhaustive reduction of 379 mg, 1 mmol dpp-IQ with excess K in 15 mL THF) added to YbI2 prepared by reduction of I2 (254 mg, 1 mmol) with excess Yb (1.73 g, 10 mmol) in 20 mL THF; KI precipitated. Stirring 2 h at room temperature, standing overnight, filtration, and the same hexane work-up gave 403 mg (68%).
synthesis.time: turned deep-green in 1 h, then stirred overnight (procedure I); 2 h stirring then overnight (procedure II)
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Schlenk-line / argon glovebox; direct metal reduction or salt metathesis
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtration, vacuum evaporation of THF, n-hexane washes, crystallization/slow extraction from n-hexane

properties.summary: Solid 1 is diamagnetic (sharp 1H and 13C NMR), supporting a [YbII(AP2−)]4 electronic structure with closed-shell Yb(II) and dianionic amidophenolate ligands.

synthesis.procedure: Analogous to 1. A vinous THF solution of dpp-IQ (379 mg, 1 mmol in 30 mL THF) was added to Eu shavings (1.52 g, 10 mmol) activated with iodine (10 mg, 0.04 mmol). After turning deep-green in 1 h, stirring overnight at ambient temperature gave a bright orange solution. Filtration, vacuum evaporation, n-hexane washes, and slow extraction with 15 mL n-hexane afforded orange crystals of 2 (488 mg, 86%). Procedure II: potassium o-amidophenolate from 379 mg (1 mmol) dpp-IQ plus excess K in 15 mL THF was added to EuI2 from I2 (254 mg, 1 mmol) and excess Eu (1.52 g, 10 mmol) in 20 mL THF; 2 h stirring, overnight standing, KI filtration, and the same work-up gave 427 mg (75%).

properties.summary: Paramagnetic Eu(II) tetramer. Room-temperature μeff = 15.44 μB matches four uncoupled Eu(II) ions; μeff is nearly constant at 100–300 K, rises to 17.05 μB at 3 K (weak ferromagnetism), then 16.16 μB at 2 K. Spin-Hamiltonian fit gives J = +0.08 cm−1 (g = 1.93) for pairwise Eu1–Eu2 coupling.

synthesis.procedure: A vinous solution of dpp-IQ (95 mg, 0.25 mmol) in 10 mL THF was added to an orange solution of 1 (147 mg, 0.0625 mmol) in 10 mL THF. The mixture turned dark-green immediately and was stirred 1 h at room temperature. THF was evaporated; the residue was treated twice with 10 mL n-hexane, evaporated, and extracted with 20 mL n-hexane. The green solution was filtered, concentrated to 5 mL, and stored at −18 °C overnight to give dark-green fine crystals of 3 (116 mg, 43%). Procedure II: potassium o-iminosemiquinolate in 15 mL THF (from 95 mg, 0.25 mmol dpp-IQ via K reduction then 0.25 mmol dpp-IQ) was added to YbI2 from I2 (64 mg, 0.25 mmol) and excess Yb (10 mmol) in 20 mL THF; 2 h stirring, overnight standing, KI filtration, and the same work-up gave 129 mg (48%).
synthesis.time: 1 h (procedure I); 2 h then overnight (procedure II); overnight crystallization
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Schlenk conditions; oxidative addition or salt metathesis
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: vacuum removal of THF, n-hexane washes and extraction, concentration, crystallization at −18 °C

synthesis.procedure: A vinous solution of dpp-IQ (95 mg, 0.25 mmol) in 10 mL THF was added to an orange solution of 2 (142 mg, 0.0625 mmol) in 10 mL THF, turning dark-green immediately. After 1 h at room temperature, THF was evaporated, the residue treated twice with 10 mL n-hexane, extracted with 20 mL n-hexane, and evaporated to dryness to give 4 as a dark-green powder (153 mg, 58%). synthesis.procedure: dpp-IQ (240 mg, 0.64 mmol) was added to a red-orange solution of 1 (375 mg, 0.64 mmol) in 10 mL toluene with stirring. The mixture turned dark-green immediately and was stirred 1 h at room temperature. Toluene was reduced to 4 mL and the concentrated solution stood at room temperature. Dark-green crystals of 3-dimer·C7H8 suitable for X-ray diffraction grew within a week and were collected by filtration (74 mg, 12%).
synthesis.time: 1 h stirring; crystal growth within a week
synthesis.vessel_or_method: oxidative addition in toluene; crystallization from concentrated toluene
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: volume reduced to 4 mL; standing at room temperature; filtration of X-ray-quality crystals
